title: Prompt Engineering Is DEAD. Start Looping Claude Code.
description:
Comment "loop" for the 2026 Loop Playbook

Still prompting Claude turn by turn in 2026?
You're working backwards.

One message, one output. It stops when you stop typing.

Loop engineering flips that.
You set the goal. The system runs 24/7, unattended.

You go from driver to factory designer.

Two ways to start:
PAUL, a loop you run. Plan, apply, unify.
Hermes, a loop that runs itself.

That's how you scale past your own hours.
